text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance inspection 
on 3 Ph, Turbo Alternator which must be performed every week, This procedure was 
applied in Damanhour Thermal Power Plant3*65mw since 1976, 
The generator data: 
81.25MVA, 10.5KV, 4.45KA, PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Fatehy AboElkher, tested by eng.Samir 
 Ouf Hassoub , accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station, 
 and certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia Diab WDEPC inspection head sector and 
 MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Work order must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence (rope) 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes, gloves ... etc.
Gas turbine out of 
 service at cold state.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete tool set
New brushes, Air blower, 
 and Spray
Digital voltmeter, megger, 
 clamp ammeter
Fine cloth and brushes 
 for cleaning purposes
Work to be carried out
Bearings
Inspect drains at oil vapour extractor and 
pressure pipes.
Seal Oil Supply System
Check oil filters and clean if required .
Coolers
Check vents .
Hydrogen System
Check gas consumption .
Inspect dry type filters and clean if 
 required .
Exciter Set
Inspect air filters and clean if 
 required .
Inspect brushes .
Hydrogen System
Check gas drier and clean if required .
Check thermal 
 gas analyzer
